title: Zesty American Chicken Wrap
description: Savory, smoky chicken wrapped in a citrus‑stevia glaze with coconut flakes for a quick, sugar‑free lunch.
instructions: Season the chicken with salt, pepper, garlic powder, soy sauce, lime zest, lime juice, and stevia for 5 minutes.
Heat a grill pan over medium‑high, place the heated binchotan charcoal cube in the center for 30 seconds, then remove it to infuse smoke.
Add the chicken to the pan and cook 6‑7 minutes per side until the internal temperature reaches 165°F.
In a small bowl, combine soy sauce, lime juice, stevia, and coconut flakes to make a glassy citrus glaze.
Brush half of the glaze over the chicken and let it caramelize for 1 minute, then flip and brush the remaining glaze.
Slice the cooked chicken into thin strips.
Warm the tortilla in the same pan for 30 seconds on each side.
Spread the remaining glaze on the tortilla, lay chicken strips, and sprinkle coconut flakes evenly.
Fold the sides and roll the tortilla into a tight wrap.
Slice the wrap in half and serve immediately.
